_doc: Fixture: a tenant client (acme) attempts to subscribe to dashboard stream with a forged tenant_id query parameter pointing at globex. The server MUST ignore the client-supplied value, resolve tenant_id strictly from the verified Clerk session, and refuse the cross-tenant smuggle attempt with HTTP 403. The §0.3 attestation envelope below is the audit-trace the gate scans for. Locked by constitution/08-APPS-DASHBOARDS.md §13 + §0.11 banking-grade isolation.

body.reason: Client-supplied tenant_id does not match session-resolved tenant_id. Refused per constitution §0.11.
